paite: Elihu in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Hiai na dikna hi in na ngaihtuah hia, ahihkeileh, kei a mawng ahi, Pathian mai ah na chi hia?
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

paite: Kei a ding in bang phattuamna a-om dia? Khial lou a ka om in bang phattuamna ka nei a? na chih.
english: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

paite: Nang leh na kiang a na lawmte ka hon dawng ding.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

paite: "Vante lam en inla, mu in; vante, nang sang a sangzaw, en in.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

paite: Na hihkhelhleh, amah dem a bang hih na hia? Na tatleknate punsak hileh, amah tung a bang hih na hia?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

paite: Diktat na hihleh, amah bang na pia a? Ahihkeileh na khut a kipan bang amu a?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

paite: Na gitlouhna in nang bang in mi ahihna thei a; na diktatna in mihing tapa ahih hampha thei hi.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

paite: Nuaisiahna atam mahmah ziak in akikoukhia ua; mihat ban ziak in panpih deih in akikou uh.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

paite: Kuamah in, 'Zan chia late hon pia, Pathian kei hon Bawlpa koi a om ahia;
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

paite: Lei a gamsate sang a hon sinsak tamzaw leh, van a vasate sang a hon pilsakzaw?' achi kei uh.
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

paite: Huai ah akikou ua, himahleh, migilou kisaktheihna ziak in, kuamah in dawnna ape kei.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

paite: Chihtaktak in Pathian in bangmah lou aza kei dia, Bangkim hihthei in leng alimsaksak kei ding hi.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

paite: "Nang ngial in houh, ‘Amah ka mu kei, athu ma ah a-om, Amah ka ngak hi,' na chih vial.
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

paite: Himahleh tu in, heh a aveh louh a, ki-otsakna leng alimsak louh ziak in;
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

paite: Huaiziak in Job in bangmah lou in akam aka ahi; theihna bei in thu atamsak ahi.”
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
